summary: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard each say outside service providers were hacked, exposing some customer names and emails. Payments were not disrupted. Equinor's cyberattack and the NSA network outage are still going. Officials say the recent outages are not linked, and stocks fell about 2% Thursday on AI worries.

events.title: JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard say outside providers were hacked
events.impact: JPMorgan says attackers got marketing data at vendors, maybe names and emails. Press reports say about 16,000 clients. Visa cites an Asia Pacific provider. Mastercard cites a benefits-program provider. No service disruption.
events.stated_cause: Hackers hit third-party vendors. A ransomware group reportedly leaked the data. JPMorgan says there is no link to Monday's outage, which it blamed on a software bug.

events.title: Equinor cyberattack on IT systems still ongoing
events.impact: Production is not affected and Equinor sees no sign of data theft. Internal email was reported down. No time estimate for full recovery. Norway's security agency is helping.
events.stated_cause: Equinor calls it a cyberattack, not a virus. It says it does not appear to target Equinor specifically. Nobody has named who did it.

events.title: NSA classified network still down on third day
events.impact: Some staff were told to work from home for a third day. A Georgia site that handles Middle East intelligence work was also hit. Officials say core intelligence collection continues.
events.stated_cause: The Director of National Intelligence blames patching of PHP software flaws that left systems not coming back up. No official source reports a cyberattack.

events.title: US stocks fell about 2% Thursday; Nasdaq in a correction
events.impact: Dow lost 1,101 to 49,097. S&P 500 fell 2.02% to 7,176. Nasdaq fell 2.25% to 23,879, which is a 10%+ drop from its high. I saw no trading halts. Friday's session has not opened.
events.stated_cause: Reports point to AI-stock worries around the Anthropic IPO and Nvidia weakness. No technical or attack cause reported.

events.title: Officials again say recent outages are unrelated and not malicious
events.impact: The administration urged calm Thursday. Homeland Security's secretary said he is 98% sure it is not a cyberattack. This is an official view, not a proven finding.
events.stated_cause: Officials point to patching, router work and software bugs. They name no attacker.

events.title: Bitcoin about 61.6K to 63.5K USD, down roughly 14% on the week
events.impact: Coinbase shows about 61,581. CoinGecko shows about 63,469 (down 1.8% in 24h, 14.1% in 7 days). Bitget shows about 62,674. It is a steady slide, not a crash. I found no exchange outage.
events.stated_cause: CoinGecko cites Fed rate-hike fears and fund outflows. No technical or attack cause reported.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: The status feed at 02:58 UTC lists degraded performance for Cloudflare Sites and Services, changed 02:52 UTC. I saw no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare has not given a cause in the data I saw.

events.title: Apple services outage (iCloud, App Store, Apple Music)
events.impact: Apple confirmed sign-in, App Store and Apple Music problems. Most systems are restored.
events.stated_cause: Apple says an internal update caused it. It ruled out a cyberattack.

events.title: Marriott sign-in outage fixed
events.impact: Marriott's website and Bonvoy app sign-in were down. Full access is restored.
events.stated_cause: Marriott says a review found no sign of a cyberattack. It did not give a technical cause in what I read.

events.title: FAA ground stop earlier; FBI still helping review
events.impact: Flights have resumed. The FAA feed at 02:58 UTC shows only weather delays at SFO, SAN and LAS. No active system outage listed.
events.stated_cause: The FAA said a new router flooded the network with data. The FBI is helping the FAA, DOT and L3Harris. No official source reports a cyberattack.

events.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to its list
events.impact: Routine notice covering Synology, LiteLLM, Apache Axis and REDCap software. I saw no new Emergency Directive. The notice does not mention the outages.
events.stated_cause: Attackers are exploiting software flaws. CISA gives no link to the outages.

events.title: United Airlines system outage briefly affected departures
events.impact: A United system outage on Monday briefly affected departures. I saw no sign it is still going.
events.stated_cause: Unknown in the data I saw.

connection_assessment.reasoning: JPMorgan blamed Monday's outage on a software bug, and says its new vendor hack is not connected. The NSA outage is blamed on software patching. Equinor is a cyberattack nobody has explained. The bank and card vendor hacks may be linked to each other (one gang reportedly claimed them), but no official source says so.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker for the outages and the vendor hacks, or several big systems failing at the same moment, would change my view.

alert.reason: No confirmed link between incidents and no widespread service failure. The new vendor data breaches did not disrupt payments.

prep_note: Watch for emails or texts from JPMorgan, Visa or Mastercard about your data. Do not click links in them. Go to the official site yourself. Keep some cash and a second payment card on hand. Check your bank app normally. Expect flight delays only from weather for now.
